newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Bannock County SD #25, Idaho.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Bannock County SD #25, Idaho.

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that sealed bids will be received until 10:00 o'clock A.M., Mountain Daylight Time, on
at the office of the Clerk of the Board of Trustees of School District No. 25, 3115 Poleline Road, P.O. Box 1390, Pocatello, Idaho 83204-1390 (the District''), for the

above issue of School District No. 25 General Obligation School Bonds, Series 1997, in the principal amount of $27,500,000 (the Bonds will be publicly opened, examined, and declared at a meeting by the Board of Trustees of the District at 12:00 o'clock Noon, Mountain Daylight Time, on said date. The Bonds will be in the denomination of $5,000 each, or integral multiples thereof within a maturity, will be dated July 1, 1997, will be dated July 1, 1997, will bear interest from their date at a net effective rate not exceeding ten percent (10.0%) per annum, payable commencing on February 1, 1998, and semiannually on each August 1 and February 1 thereafter, and will be due serially on August 1 in the years and amounts as follows:

All Bonds of the same maturity must bear a single rate of interest, and the rate bid for each succeeding maturity of the Bonds maturing after August 1, 2007, must increase except to the extent that the rate bid for two or more consecutive maturities is repeated. A zero rate cannot be named for all or part of the time from the date of any Bond to its stated maturity.
The Bonds will be issued in book-entry-only form, in accordance with the book-entry only practices of The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York.

Bonds maturing on or before August 1, 2007, are not subject to call or redemption prior to their stated dates of maturity. On any date on or after August 1, 2007, the Bonds maturing on or after August 1, 2008, shall be subject to redemption, in whole or in part, from maturities or portions of maturities selected by the District (and by lot selected
by the Bond Registrar within a maturity), at the redem price, expressed as a percentage of the principal amount of each Bond to be redeemed, of 100%, plus accrued interest to the redemption date.

No bids for less than the par amount of the Bonds plus accrued interest from the date of the Bonds to the date of delivery will be accepted. The Bonds will be sold to the bidder offering the lowest effective interest cost to the District, determined on a true interest cost basis. All bids must be accompanied by a good faith deposit in the amount of $550,000. Interest will not be allowed to the bidder on the good faith deposit. The approving legal opinion will be furnished by the law firm of Moore& McFadden, Chartered, Boise, Idaho. Copies of the Official Statement and Notice of Sale and other related information with respect to said Bonds may be obtained from First Security Bank, N.A., Public Finance Department, 41 East 100 South, 3rd Floor, Salt Lake City, Utah 84111, telephone: (801) 246-5797, or the District Treasurer, telephone: (801) 232-3563.
